data.description:
## Description

**What**: Author canon entries in the reference-library corpus (per epic 0b7c-d811's schema) for USWDS forms, GOV.UK error/form patterns, VA.gov error anatomy, 18F content guide, Federal Plain Language Guidelines, and CDC reading-level guidance.
**Why**: Without authored canon entries, the gov-copy-writer agent has nothing to retrieve via ref-query.sh and cannot apply the federal style canon required by sc-6.
**Scope**:
- IN: corpus entries from all 6 sources with stable rule_ids; ref-query.sh retrievability with relevance scoring; hard_constraint boolean on each entry; documented precedence ladder; corpus-README documentation
- OUT: gov-copy-writer agent that loads the entries (separate story); coordination-pass enforcement of immutability (separate story)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, canon entries from USWDS forms, GOV.UK error/form patterns, VA.gov error anatomy, 18F content guide, Federal Plain Language Guidelines, and CDC reading-level guidance exist in the reference-library corpus with stable rule_ids
  ← Satisfies: sc-6 (sc-6: "federal style canon ships as entries in the reference library corpus, retrievable via ref-query.sh")
- When this story is complete, `dso ref-query` against a representative UI-copy query returns canon entries from the new corpus with relevance scores
  ← Satisfies: sc-6
- When this story is complete, each canon entry carries a hard_constraint boolean (true for errors, validation, legal disclosures; false otherwise)
  ← Satisfies: sc-5 (sc-5: "items whose rule_ids cite a hard-constraint canon rule cannot be mutated"), sc-6
- When this story is complete, the precedence ladder (canon-rule > Copy Needs constraint > Users archetype > design-notes voice) is documented in the corpus README or a canon-overview entry
  ← Satisfies: sc-6
- When this story is complete, each canon entry carries a single documented semantic for hard_constraint as defined in the canon schema (true means errors/validation/legal disclosures and any rule_ids citation makes the owning item immutable to coordination-pass mutation), and consumers can rely on this semantic identically
  ← Satisfies: sc-6
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations
- [Dependency] Epic 0b7c-d811 (closed) provides the corpus schema and ref-query.sh.
- [Source-cadence] Cite source URLs and capture dates; canon entries are version-pinned, not live-fetched.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a gov-copy-writer dispatch, I have federal-style-canon entries in the reference corpus retrievable via ref-query.sh
